name: Iori
message: 「Morning, everyone！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Good morning, Iori-sensei.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Oh? You’re early, Teach. What’s up?」
It was still quite a bit before class, but having nothing else to do, I’d come to the classroom a little early.

name: Iori
message: 「Oh, I just happened to wake up early.」
A quick glance around the classroom showed only Asahi and Ririmu present.
And in the corner of the room, Keisetsu was projecting a hologram and working on something.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Hmm… typical of the Suzakuin, I suppose. Trying to intervene in personnel affairs seems a bit of a stretch, though.」

name: Iori
message: 「What are you doing? Just what…」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Oh, you’re here. I’m just fulfilling my duties, so don’t mind me.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「It’s still early for class, but are you starting already？」

name: Iori
message: 「No, Setsugekka and Momiji haven’t arrived yet. We’ll start once everyone’s here.」
As we were talking, I heard voices from the hallway. Speak of the devil, the two of them arrived.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Goooooood morning!」

name: Momiji
message: 「Ugh, morning…」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Whoa, Momitchi, your energy is super low. What’s up, what happened？」
Momiji had a dejected look on her face as she walked in. And a small shadow was following behind her.

name: Miyako
message: 「Good morning!」

name: Iori
message: 「H-huh… Miyako-chan？」
Miyako-chan had appeared along with Setsugekka and Momiji.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Attention, everyone! Who might this cute girl be?」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Oh, I know！ She’s gotta be Teach’s secret love child！」

name: Iori
message: 「No, she isn’t, okay…？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Iori-sensei, by all means, let’s make a secret love child together too.」

name: Iori
message: 「Asahi, you don’t have to go along with that, either！？」

name: Miyako
message: 「Nice to meet you. I’m Suzakuin Miyako, Momiji-onee-chan’s little sister. It’s a pleasure to meet you all.」
Miyako-chan was smiling, surrounded by everyone. Yep, she’s such a good girl for being able to greet everyone so properly！

name: Ririmu
message: 「Whoa, so you're Momicchi's little sister. Now that you mention it, you guys do look alike？ Miyako-cchi, I'm Ririmu. Nice to meet ya~！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「She's way more level-headed than Momimomi usually is, huh~」

name: Momiji
message: 「Shut it, none of your business.」

name: Iori
message: 「Welcome to the Takamura Class, Miyako-chan. Glad to have you.」

name: Miyako
message: 「Iori-sensei, thank you very much.」

name: Iori
message: 「No problem. Miyako-chan, you really are such a good girl~」
My face softens involuntarily.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Se-sensei, you're making such a super lovey-dovey face right now.」

name: Asahi
message: 「It seems you still love children even now, don't you.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I have a frank question, if I may, Momiji-san.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Yeah, yeah, what is it？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「You brought your sister to the academy, but what exactly do you intend to do with her？」

name: Momiji
message: 「'Brought her' is more like, she just showed up on her own...」

name: Iori
message: 「I'll explain the situation from here.」
I explain the circumstances to everyone in the Takamura Class.
That Miyako-chan ran away from home and came to this academy. And that she is currently being put up in Momiji's room.

name: Iori
message: 「Due to various family circumstances, we've settled on Momiji taking care of her for a while.」

name: Iori
message: 「I'd appreciate it if you all could help out if possible.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yup, yup, nice to meet you, Miyako-chan!」

name: Miyako
message: 「Once again, it's a pleasure to meet you all.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I understand the situation now.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「But what will you do about bringing Miyako-san into the classroom? Do you intend to have her attend lessons with us?」

name: Momiji
message: 「Ah~ about that...」

name: Iori
message: 「Miyako-chan is still small, after all. It’s only natural she’d stay with her guardian, Momiji.」

name: Iori
message: 「You don't need to worry about it, Momiji.」

name: Momiji
message: 「T-Thank you.」

name: Iori
message: 「Whenever your hands are full with training or anything, I'll look after her for you, so don't worry.」

name: Iori
message: 「Is that okay with you too, Miyako-chan？」

name: Miyako
message: 「Yeah, okay.」
Mm-hm, what a sweet, obedient little girl.
Yesterday she suspected I might be some shady guy, so I guess she's decided I'm safe after all.

name: Iori
message: 「All right then, everyone's here, so let's start class a little early. Move on to your usual training regimens.」

name: Iori
message: 「Miyako-chan's watching too, so put some spirit into it！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Yeah, yeah, take good care of Miyako, okay~...」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Man, you're always so low-energy, Momitchi.」
At my prompting, everyone begins working on their respective regimens.

name: Miyako
message: 「What should I do？」

name: Iori
message: 「Let's see... First, I'd love it if you could just watch without getting in everyone's way.」

name: Iori
message: 「If there's anything you don't understand, feel free to ask me anything. I'll teach you all about it~！」

name: Miyako
message: 「Oka~y♪」
Precious... Having a kid in class really is the best, huh. Today's gonna be a fun day！

name: Setsugekka
message: 「N-Nngh... Uoryaaaaah！！」

name: Miyako
message: 「You can do it, Setsugekka-san. Just a little more~」
Miyako-chan is cheering on Setsugekka, who's doing strength training with her face bright red.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「L-Leave it to meee... Th-This much is a piece of cake♪」

name: Miyako
message: 「Three more to go, you can do it！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hnnnghh! If it's to beat Momimomi, this much is nothiiing...!!」

name: Miyako
message: 「Do you want to beat Momiji-oneechan, Setsugekka-san？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I'll beat her, I'll definitely beat her! Because that's my destiny!」

name: Iori
message: 「Whoa, ten percent more weight? Setsugekka, it's great to work hard, just don't overdo it, okay?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hwaaah, I kno~w！ I'm starting to get used to it anyway... I got this！」

name: Miyako
message: 「But why is Setsugekka-san doing muscle training? You don't really need that much muscle strength for Jindou, right?」

name: Iori
message: 「Wow, you can tell that much, Miyako-chan！ It's true that muscle strength isn't the only thing you need.」

name: Iori
message: 「But Setsugekka’s fighting style is a bit unique. Muscle strength and stamina are indispensable for her.」

name: Miyako
message: 「Hmm, is that so.」
Miyako-chan nods in admiration.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「But moving your body feels super great, you know~♪ Haa, haa... aaaaand, done~♪」

name: Miyako
message: 「Amazing, congrats~！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Thanks~, Miyako-chan. Oh, Miyako-chan, you really are such a good girl~！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yep, I’m retiring from being the 'Absolute Destroyer of Suzakuin.' From now on, I’m the 'Absolute Destroyer of Momiji.'」

name: Miyako
message: 「'Absolute Destroyer'…？」
Miyako-chan looks puzzled.
Oh well, next up are the members using Yorishiro-kun. Let's go see how Asahi is doing first.

name: Asahi
message: 「…！ Right there, taaaah！！」

name: Miyako
message: 「Wow… hey, hey, what is Asahi-san doing？」

name: Iori
message: 「That’s training to discern the 'incipience.' It’s about reading the opponent's movements so you can respond optimally.」
Incipience refers to the tell-tale sign before an opponent performs an action. She is executing a perfect Iai in sync with Yorishiro-kun's movements.

name: Iori
message: 「Yorishiro-kun is pretty tough, too. Your technique has become sharper than before. Keep it up.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Thank you, Iori-sensei.」

name: Iori
message: 「Keep up the good work.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes!」

name: Miyako
message: 「Do your best, Asahi-san~！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Thank you, Miyako-chan. But I won’t yield on Sensei.」

name: Iori
message: 「Asahi, don't show such rivalry toward someone so small.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Iori-sensei, you were kinder to me when I was small. In other words, I figured that was just your preference.」

name: Iori
message: 「My fondness for kids doesn’t mean it like that！？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Hehehe, I hope that's the case」
...Let's pull ourselves together and move on.

name: Iori
message: 「Next up is Ririmu」

name: Miyako
message: 「Huh？ Come to think of it, isn't Keisetsu-san practicing？」

name: Iori
message: 「Ah, Keisetsu is in the same Takamura Class as us, but she's in the Quartermaster Division. She's not a swordsman」

name: Miyako
message: 「Hmm, what a waste, she looks so strong」

name: Iori
message: 「Hahaha, everyone has their own strengths and weaknesses, you know」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Oh, Iorin and Miyako-chan. Hey hey~！」

name: Iori
message: 「How's it going？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Right now, I'm using Yorishiro-kun to pick my next opponent. I was hoping for someone a little stronger」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I'm going to take down every single registered Toujinegi！」

name: Iori
message: 「That's reassuring to hear」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Come to think of it, while I was looking for Toujinegi data, I found something that caught my eye」

name: Iori
message: 「Hm？ Which one is it？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Look at this, a guy named Kuki Takahisa」
That's right, he became a Toujinegi in his first year, so...

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hm? What's wrong, Sensei? You've got a scary look on your face」

name: Iori
message: 「A-ah, sorry. Don't worry about it」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hey, this Kuki... could he be an acquaintance of that Oni woman？」

name: Iori
message: 「Acquaintance is one way to put it; Kuki Takahisa is her older brother」

name: Ririmu
message: 「No way, the Oni woman's big bro was a Toujinegi！？」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, that's right. He was a user of the same Iai sword-drawing style as Asahi, and he was incredibly strong」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hmm, so if I can beat this guy Takahisa, that means I can clear Asahi too？」

name: Iori
message: 「That's right, I think it will be a great reference for when you face Asahi」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I see~, then I think I'll give it a try！」

name: Miyako
message: 「Good luck~, Ririmu-san」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Oh yeah, leave it to me~♪」
I took Miyako-chan around to see everything there was to see.

name: Iori
message: 「How was it, Miyako-chan? Was it interesting?」

name: Miyako
message: 「Everyone is actually pretty strong, aren't they?」

name: Iori
message: 「Oh? You can even tell how strong they are?」

name: Miyako
message: 「Yeah, out of those three, the strongest-looking one is Asahi-san. Next is Ririmu-san, and Setsugekka-san is... average？」

name: Miyako
message: 「It's just a feeling, but I don't think she's very strong.」

name: Miyako
message: 「The strongest one is probably Momiji-oneechan.」
Heh, I'm surprised. Excluding Setsugekka's berserk state, that's a spot-on ranking.

name: Miyako
message: 「Iori-sensei, I want to try a match too~」

name: Iori
message: 「I see, so you've already started Jindou, Miyako-chan. Out of everyone here, who would you want to fight？」

name: Miyako
message: 「I want to fight you, Iori-sensei!」

name: Iori
message: 「Huh? Me！?」

name: Miyako
message: 「Yeah, because I think you're the strongest one here, Iori-sensei. I want to fight against strong people.」
Miyako-chan directs her innocent, combative spirit straight at me.

name: Iori
message: 「I see... Yeah, sure. Let's go see how Momiji is doing, and then we'll have a sparring match.」

name: Miyako
message: 「Yay~~♪ Thank you, Sensei~」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, yeah, you're welcome.」
Ah, she's so cute... Kids really are the best.
With a soft smile, I took Miyako-chan and headed over to Momiji.
